items.q: I don't know which treatment to choose. Where should I start?
items.a: With a face and skin assessment, or a body assessment: 30 minutes, €30. Your practitioner looks, asks questions and suggests a treatment or a programme. The €30 is deducted if you then choose a programme.

Yes, with suitable treatments. We offer a pregnancy drainage (40 min). Some technologies, such as radiofrequency or lipocavitation, are not used during pregnancy. Mention it when booking and check with your doctor or midwife.

Yes, depending on the technique: pregnancy, some medical treatments, circulation problems, implants, skin conditions in a flare-up. We check them at the assessment. If in doubt, we refer you to a health professional.

items.q: How many sessions will I need?
items.a: It depends on your goal. A single treatment feels good, but some results need regularity: that is what the 30-day, 6-week and 90-day programmes are for. We discuss it at the assessment.

drainage.metaTitle: Renata França lymphatic drainage in Amiens | The Body by Ami
drainage.metaDescription: Renata França lymphatic drainage in Amiens: 1 hour, €150. A lighter feeling, less bloating, lighter legs. Pregnancy version available. Book online.
drainage.title: Lymphatic drainage in Amiens
drainage.intro: The institute's most requested drainage, and the one clients mention most in their reviews. Fast, rhythmic, firm movements that work on water retention and bloating.

sections.title: A method, not a relaxing massage
sections.text: The Renata França method combines precise pressure and pumping movements in a set sequence. The pace is brisk: this is not a massage to fall asleep to, but focused work on lymph flow.

sections.title: How it feels
sections.text: Many clients describe feeling lighter, less bloated and with less heavy legs as they leave. The effect varies with each body and lifestyle: we do not promise weight loss.

sections.title: On its own or as a programme
sections.text: One session before an event, or the Body Reset: three drainages, three dome sauna sessions and a Miracle Face over 30 days.

for: Before an event, a trip, a wedding
After a tired or stressful period
drainage.contra: Drainage is not performed with untreated circulation problems, an ongoing infection or some medical treatments. Pregnant? We offer an adapted drainage (40 min, €75), with your doctor's approval.

faq.q: How many drainage sessions do I need?
faq.a: One session is enough to feel the effect. To make it last, we recommend several sessions close together, as in the Body Reset programme (3 drainages over 30 days).
Drink plenty of water the day before and on the day, and avoid a heavy meal just before. Please be on time: the protocol lasts a full hour.
The movements are firm and fast, but should not hurt. Tell your practitioner if the pressure bothers you and she will adjust it.

kobido.metaTitle: Kobido Japanese facial massage in Amiens | The Body by Ami
kobido.metaDescription: Kobido in Amiens: Japanese facial massage, 1h15, €120. Brighter complexion, rested features, released tension. Book online at The Body by Ami.
kobido.title: Kobido in Amiens
kobido.intro: Kobido is a facial massage from Japan. Precise, rhythmic and sometimes very fast movements that bring back radiance, work on firmness and release tension.

sections.title: A manual lift
sections.text: With no needles or devices, Kobido works the tissues of the face, neck and neckline. The movements alternate tapping, kneading and smoothing.

sections.title: How it feels
sections.text: A more rested face, a fresher complexion and real relaxation. Kobido is also one of the treatments our clients most often give as a gift.

sections.title: With Face Pilates
sections.text: Kobido is part of the Face Reset programme, along with a Signature Face Pilates and a session chosen for your face.

kobido.contra: Kobido is not recommended with inflamed or broken skin, or just after an injection or a medical facial procedure. We check this with you before starting.

faq.q: What is the difference between Kobido and Face Pilates?
faq.a: Kobido is a Japanese massage with set movements. Signature Face Pilates is a longer protocol (1h30) that adds muscle work, facial stretching and sometimes intra-oral work.

faq.q: Can I wear make-up after Kobido?
faq.a: It is best to let your skin breathe for a few hours. If possible, come and leave without make-up.

faq.q: How often should I have Kobido?
faq.a: Once a month to maintain, or more often over a short period, before an event for example.

facePilates.metaTitle: Signature Face Pilates in Amiens, Ami's facial | The Body by Ami
facePilates.metaDescription: Signature Face Pilates in Amiens: 1h30, €190. The hands-on face protocol developed by Ami: muscles, tension, drainage and skin quality. Book online.
facePilates.title: Signature Face Pilates in Amiens
facePilates.intro: The house signature, developed by Ami. An hour and a half of hands-on work on the whole face: muscles, tension, tissue mobility and skin quality.

sections.title: Never the same twice
sections.text: No two faces age the same way. The protocol adapts to your features: jawline, cheekbones, eyes, jaw, forehead or deeper lines.

sections.title: 1h30 of manual work
sections.text: Facial muscle work, stretching, deep sculpting moves, drainage when the face is puffy, and intra-oral work when it is useful, to reach some tension in the lower face.

sections.title: Over time
sections.text: Face Pilates is at the heart of the Face Reset (30 days) and Face Longevity (90 days) programmes, with photo follow-up.

for: A puffy face in the morning
Caring for your face without injections
facePilates.contra: The treatment is adapted or postponed with broken skin, a cold sore flare-up, or just after an injection or medical facial procedure. We discuss it at the assessment.

faq.a: They are different things and we do not present it that way. Face Pilates is manual work, with no needles: it works on tension, tone and skin quality, at its own pace.

faq.q: How many sessions before I see a difference?
faq.a: Many clients see a more rested face after the first session. For ongoing work, the Face Reset programme includes three over 30 days.
A few movements inside the cheek, with gloves, to reach certain muscles of the lower face. It is only done when useful, and with your consent.

headSpa.metaTitle: Head spa in Amiens, scalp ritual | The Body by Ami
headSpa.metaDescription: Head spa in Amiens: relaxing 1h at €85, Signature 1h30 at €160, for two or for children aged 4 to 10. Scalp cleansing, water and massage. Book online.
headSpa.title: Head spa in Amiens
headSpa.intro: A water ritual for the scalp: a look at your scalp, cleansing, care and massage of the head, neck and shoulders. You close your eyes; we take care of the rest.

sections.title: How the ritual goes
sections.text: We start by looking at your scalp and talking about your habits. Then scalp and hair are cleansed with products chosen for you, before the care and massage, in soft light.

sections.title: Relaxing or Signature
sections.text: The relaxing head spa includes 45 minutes of care. The Signature, our most complete protocol, goes further with the treatments and massage. Both are available for two, side by side.

sections.title: Drying
sections.text: You dry your hair yourself, with a hairdryer provided. No blow-dry or styling is done.

for: Time for two: mother and daughter, friends, couples
Children aged 4 to 10, with “My first head spa”
headSpa.contra: Tell us about any scalp lesion, recent surgery or pregnancy: the ritual is then adapted.

faq.q: Should I come with clean hair?
faq.a: No, the ritual starts with cleansing. Just avoid elaborate hairstyles or fragile extensions.

faq.q: Can two people have a head spa together?
faq.a: Yes: the duo head spa, relaxing or Signature, is done side by side. The listed price covers both people.

faq.q: How does the children's head spa work?
faq.a: “My first head spa” lasts 30 minutes, for ages 4 to 10: a gentle ritual suited to their age, with a parent present.
